verdict.rationale: Proton Pass documents a first-party desktop app for Windows, macOS, and Linux, with offline access to everything in your vaults and vault organization, so vault access on the computer is clearly delivered. TOTP code generation is documented for Proton Pass generally but is never tied to the desktop app, so the 'codes on my computer' half is only implied. Older 2023 community comments saying there was no desktop app predate the current desktop-app docs and do not concretely contradict them. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that the desktop app generates and shows TOTP codes, independent hands-on corroboration of the desktop app.

support.subject: As a power user, a first-class desktop app gives me codes and vault access on my computer, not just on mobile

citations.quote: Our desktop app is available for Windows, macOS, and Linux.
Everything in your vaults is accessible whether you’re connected to the internet or not.
Vaults can be used to organize items
Proton Pass can securely generate TOTP codes for websites that you have saved login details for.
